messages:
Leo (Support): FYI FinzTech is blocked on onboarding — procurement insists on a signed PO before they will accept any invoices. They want us to withhold billing until PO is in place.
James (AM): Confirmed — FinzTech procurement emailed this morning. They said no invoice will be processed without a PO # and vendor setup completed. They also requested our billing address + W9.
Sarah (Billing): Can we issue a pro-forma invoice or a quote that they can attach the PO to? If so, what PO fields do they need to match on our side (PO #, billing address, contact email)?
James (AM): Procurement listed: PO#, vendor name, vendor tax id, billing address, payment terms (Net30). They explicitly rejected paying by card.
Emily (Legal): From contract perspective we can accept PO as an order confirmation, but we need a matching legal name and address. If they supply a PO that contradicts the signed agreement (different legal entity) we need to validate.
billing-bot: Automated note: current account status = pending_billing. No active invoices issued.
Leo (Support): Customer's PR included this snippet:```
PO#: FT-8921
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Bill To: FinzTech Ltd, Procurement Team
Payment Terms: Net30
```
Leo (Support): They asked for an invoice that references that PO#. They said finance won't pay otherwise.
Sarah (Billing): Ok — we can generate an invoice draft with PO# field filled and mark it as "Pending — awaiting PO" in our system. But we need someone to confirm the exact bill-to address and VAT info (they're UK registered). Do we have their VAT reg number?
James (AM): Client says VAT number is GB999888777. Procurement insists invoice must show VAT reverse-charge note, not our VAT charged.
Emily (Legal): For reverse-charge we need their VAT + a statement on invoice: "VAT reverse charged to customer under Article 193" (or local equivalent). Finance should consult tax team.
Sarah (Billing): I'll add a draft invoice with PO FT-8921 and the reverse-charge note, but we need internal approval to mark invoice as final without PO signature. Can we accept a scanned PO email from procurement as sufficient?
Leo (Support): Procurement sent an email from procurement@finztech.com with the PO attached (PDF). I uploaded it to the ticket.
Sarah (Billing): Good — if the PO PDF includes the PO#, vendor name and billing address, that usually suffices to attach to invoice. I'll keep the invoice in draft until we get explicit sign-off from legal on the VAT phrasing.
James (AM): Customer is asking if we can provision the dev keys while billing is held. They want to start integration work. Can we issue temporary keys with usage caps? :thinking_face:
Leo (Support): We can create a temporary API key with 0 billing enabled (no spend) or limited quota, but procurement warned they won't allow any billed activity. We should avoid enabling any production-scale usage.
Sarah (Billing): OK — process I propose: 1) Billing creates draft invoice referencing PO FT-8921 with VAT reverse-charge note; 2) Attach PO PDF; 3) Legal approves wording; 4) Once PO is acknowledged in our system we flip invoice status to "Issued" and send to procurement email.
Emily (Legal): That flow works. Note: we must verify the legal entity name in the PO matches the signed MSA. If mismatch, route to contracts for review.
Leo (Support): I'll leave a checklist in the ticket: upload PO PDF, confirm VAT#, confirm legal name, draft invoice created, create dev-limited API key.
James (AM): I'll let FinzTech know the plan and ask procurement to confirm the billing address/PO signature ASAP. I'll also propose a temporary staging key so they can begin non-billed integration.
Sarah (Billing): One more: confirm if they require invoice to be sent to a specific AR email (ap@finztech.com) vs procurement. Otherwise it sits in procurement queue.
Leo (Support): They provided ap@finztech.com in the PO. I attached that too.
Emily (Legal): If everything matches, we can issue the invoice once PO is attached. If their procurement policy requires explicit "no invoice until PO" language, mark invoice as "Issued - Do not process without PO" or leave as draft until PO signature present.
James (AM): Thanks team. I’ll chase procurement and update here. :thumbsup: 
Sarah (Billing): Will follow up once draft invoice created.
Leo (Support): Closing loop — ticket updated with PO and next steps.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: 72h follow-up if no PO attached.
